title: Parsley Health section heading
description: A small tracked-capital eyebrow over a light book-serif title in forest with slightly tight tracking: hero (36→64px), section (36→48px) or card (32→36px) sizes, aligned left, centred, or centred on phones only.
notes: needs a display serif in the theme; inside a .dark band or a coloured band pass tone="inherit" so it takes the band's text colour
